<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.31</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.31">Released</a> on December 02, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump decode-uri-component from 0.2.0 to 0.2.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#6616)</li>
<li>Add component updater utility @Revolyssup (#6582)</li>
<li>Redirect to login in case of no cookie @MUzairS15 (#6595)</li>
<li>Fix : icons and checkbox bg @harkiratsm (#6591)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Improve error messages for system context commands #6268 @devkapilbansal (#6613)</li>
<li>Fix failing mesheryctl tests @Revolyssup (#6593)</li>
<li>[Mesheryctl] View/Delete Configurations  @harkiratsm (#6174)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Added service mesh Icons in Navigator @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6614)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 12.3.1 to 13.0.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6620)</li>
<li>Fix: console errors on hovering navigator-icons @moki1202 (#6590)</li>
<li>Bug fixed position on menu in text field @Udit-takkar (#6550)</li>
<li>Bump tar from 6.1.11 to 6.1.12 in /ui @dependabot (#6463)</li>
<li>Add no-referrer meta tag to fix 403 google avatars @nishantwrp (#6589)</li>
<li>fix: ui-integration tests are unable to start @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6584)</li>
<li>[UI] fix: use proptypes to fix type error @Udit-takkar (#6556)</li>
<li>Fix: extension crash, while closing RJSF Form abruptly @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6583)</li>
<li>Changed icons to SVG on RJSF form @asubedy (#6578)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 12.3.1 to 13.0.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6620)</li>
<li>Bump react-relay and @types/react-relay in /ui @dependabot (#6599)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.31.10 to 7.31.11 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6607)</li>
<li>Bump decode-uri-component from 0.2.0 to 0.2.2 in /ui @dependabot (#6617)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 10.11.0 to 11.2.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6605)</li>
<li>Bump gonum.org/v1/gonum from 0.11.0 to 0.12.0 @dependabot (#6601)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/prometheus/client_golang from 1.13.0 to 1.14.0 @dependabot (#6600)</li>
<li>Bump tar from 6.1.11 to 6.1.12 in /ui @dependabot (#6463)</li>
<li>Bump golang.org/x/text from 0.3.7 to 0.4.0 @dependabot (#6465)</li>
<li>[CI] Only run build workflow on upstream @leecalcote (#6585)</li>
<li>fix: ui-integration tests are unable to start @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6584)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>The search bar is now not colliding with the Navbar from 768px to 995px  @UtkarshMishra12 (#6615)</li>
<li>Update aks.md @acald-creator (#6588)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Harshit-Dandriyal, @MUzairS15, @Nikhil-Ladha, @Revolyssup, @Udit-takkar, @UtkarshMishra12, @acald-creator, @asubedy, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @devkapilbansal, @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @moki1202, @nishantwrp and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.32</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.32">Released</a> on December 05, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Always redirect to remote provide for playground deployments @Revolyssup (#6633)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Improve error message for mesheryctl mesh @PratikforCoding (#6625)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Krishna2323/issue/Icons-To_SVG @Krishna2323 (#6630)</li>
<li>[Extensions] Meshery logo update for extensions @Chadha93 (#6635)</li>
<li>[UI] Make catalog toggling as a user preference @Chadha93 (#6450)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CD] Transition playground deployment VM-based to K8s-based @leecalcote (#6622)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Chadha93, @Krishna2323, @PratikforCoding, @Revolyssup, @leecalcote and @theBeginner86</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.34</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.34">Released</a> on December 09, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Update the save design toaster verbiage @Chadha93 (#6661)</li>
<li>add make commands to debug in Docker extension @harkiratsm (#6654)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[chore] Removing deprecated packages @acald-creator (#6667)</li>
<li>[server] Add Support To Logout Remote Provider Session @theBeginner86 (#6580)</li>
<li>Enabled navigation of application grid @hs05june (#6655)</li>
<li>[RJSF] Add a Custom Object Field to fix validation errors | CU-3u6yyf2 @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6660)</li>
<li><MesheryConfigComponent> fixed the conflicting label @partik03 (#6657)</li>
<li>Made Configuration Icon consistent @hs05june (#6650)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[server] Add Support To Logout Remote Provider Session @theBeginner86 (#6580)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[chore] Removing deprecated packages @acald-creator (#6667)</li>
<li>Update meshmodels and meshmodel workflows @Revolyssup (#6659)</li>
<li>Update helm-chart-releaser.yml @acald-creator (#6649)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump nokogiri from 1.13.9 to 1.13.10 in /docs @dependabot (#6658)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.35</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.35">Released</a> on December 14, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix panic @Revolyssup (#6707)</li>
<li>Fix failing queries in case of custom telemetry deployment @MUzairS15 (#6705)</li>
<li>Update script to add publish flag @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6704)</li>
<li>Allow save operation for alternative format directly @Revolyssup (#6679)</li>
<li>Remove overzealous notifications of design/app save @Revolyssup (#6697)</li>
<li>Update contributing.md @Anand-Theertha (#6688)</li>
<li>Edited Repository Overview Link @BabyElias (#6663)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Improve the error messages in <code>mesheryctl mesh</code>  @debasishbsws (#6626)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>disable some functionality in playground @harkiratsm (#6706)</li>
<li>Instant fix of dashboard page.  @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6709)</li>
<li>[Extension] show SignUp Form in Playground for restricted users to extension @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6703)</li>
<li>Fixed telemetry bug and organized telemetry components @MUzairS15 (#6693)</li>
<li>Temp fix to get animated logo css style for Next.js to compile @acald-creator (#6684)</li>
<li>Ellipsis property added for button in context-switcher @deepakdinesh1123 (#6671)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>updated gh workflows to ubuntu version 22.04 @StarTrooper08 (#6689)</li>
<li>Add token while checking out Meshery repo @Revolyssup (#6696)</li>
<li>Add token while checking out Meshery repo @Revolyssup (#6695)</li>
<li>Remove /docs path mandate on component updater @Revolyssup (#6694)</li>
<li>Add path to commit action @Revolyssup (#6692)</li>
<li>Add cron as trigger for component updation in docs @Revolyssup (#6691)</li>
<li>[Draft] Add flag to update docs from spreadsheet @Revolyssup (#6682)</li>
<li>[cleanup] Remove extraneous debug logs @theBeginner86 (#6668)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add <code>system dashboard</code> to the mesheryctl command reference index @alphaX86 (#6643)</li>
<li>Bump loofah from 2.18.0 to 2.19.1 in /docs @dependabot (#6699)</li>
<li>Bump rails-html-sanitizer from 1.4.3 to 1.4.4 in /docs @dependabot (#6698)</li>
<li>Edited repository overview link @BabyElias (#6664)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Anand-Theertha, @BabyElias, @Chadha93, @Harshit-Dandriyal, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @StarTrooper08, @acald-creator, @alphaX86, @debasishbsws, @deepakdinesh1123, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.36</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.36">Released</a> on December 22, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix bug on /api/meshmodel/components/types @Revolyssup (#6763)</li>
<li>[Server] MeshModel Updater Comments and Doc @leecalcote (#6748)</li>
<li>Add &ldquo;Kubernetes&rdquo; in meshmodel components @Revolyssup (#6751)</li>
<li>Fix APIVersion bug in Meshmodel components @Revolyssup (#6757)</li>
<li>Move meshmodel components under &ldquo;components&rdquo; folder @leecalcote (#6745)</li>
<li>Replace carriage return with newline @Revolyssup (#6743)</li>
<li>Add meshmodel components in Dockerfile @Revolyssup (#6741)</li>
<li>Replace &ldquo;output&rdquo; with &ldquo;meshmodel_components&rdquo; @Revolyssup (#6740)</li>
<li>Add meshmodel components @Revolyssup (#6738)</li>
<li>[MeshModel] Add support for <code>Relationships</code> @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6717)</li>
<li>Change prettification logic @Revolyssup (#6727)</li>
<li>Add apiVersion of a component in Design @Revolyssup (#6721)</li>
<li>Move from draft-04 to draft-07 for k8s components @Revolyssup (#6723)</li>
<li>Lowercase true/false in generated markdown @Revolyssup (#6720)</li>
<li>Add configmap used to configure playground ingress @Revolyssup (#6676)</li>
<li>Use helm chart name as dir @Revolyssup (#6716)</li>
<li>Fix #6713 @Revolyssup (#6714)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Playground] Fix CORS issue during logout | CU-85zrgczty @theBeginner86 (#6730)</li>
<li>[UI] Confirmation modal active tag background update @Chadha93 (#6759)</li>
<li>cursor event &amp; Delete Icon  @harkiratsm (#6750)</li>
<li>[UI] Fix style bug with Validation modal btn and Update spec verbiage @Chadha93 (#6753)</li>
<li>fix: add tooltip on actions buttons @Udit-takkar (#6551)</li>
<li>[UI] Add Sidebar Peek for Notification Center @theBeginner86 (#6737)</li>
<li>[UI] Playground modal to Deploy Meshery locally | CU-333dqt2 @Chadha93 (#6729)</li>
<li>[UI] Icon change for clearing the notification  @suhail34 (#6579)</li>
<li>[UI] ConfirmationModal - Changed the order of tabs @partik03 (#6725)</li>
<li>Added Delete Modal in Grid view @hs05june (#6724)</li>
<li>[UI] Change verify to validate and positions of button in card and table update @Chadha93 (#6718)</li>
<li>Made settings consistent with the UI @partik03 (#6678)</li>
<li>[UI] Update verbiage, format of snackbars(Meshery UI) and server logs(mesheryctl). @Chadha93 (#6702)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Playground] Fix CORS issue during logout | CU-85zrgczty @theBeginner86 (#6730)</li>
<li>[UI] Add Sidebar Peek for Notification Center @theBeginner86 (#6737)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">

</h2>
<ul>
<li>Added Fossa Badge in Readme @hs05june (#6710)</li>

</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.38</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.38">Released</a> on December 23, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Convert 2 API calls to 1 for Applications  @Revolyssup (#6752)</li>
<li>Send notification of deployment failure @Revolyssup (#6772)</li>
<li>Updated Guide for setting up meshery in Windows (special instruction for the compiler) @UtkarshMishra12 (#6764)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Solved Issue 6754 for Designs Page @hs05june (#6758)</li>
<li>FlushMeshSync button in actions column of environment settings centered @deepakdinesh1123 (#6675)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Chadha93, @Revolyssup, @UtkarshMishra12, @deepakdinesh1123, @hs05june, @leecalcote and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.39</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.39">Released</a> on December 29, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix NoAuth logic with respect to provider enforcement @Revolyssup (#6808)</li>
<li>Upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#6795)</li>
<li>Continue MeshModel registeration ignoring failure @Revolyssup (#6796)</li>
<li>Add &ldquo;Application&rdquo; to MeshModel components @Revolyssup (#6677)</li>
<li>Fix Applications import bug @Revolyssup (#6793)</li>
<li>Return source type with application update responsne @Revolyssup (#6789)</li>
<li>Allow POST on /api/application @Revolyssup (#6787)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Design Configurator : fonts, tooltips refractor @harkiratsm (#6755)</li>
<li>Fix not able to upload JSON Board @MUzairS15 (#6802)</li>
<li>fix: use optional chaining in /patterns @Udit-takkar (#6785)</li>
<li>[cypress] migrate to cypress version 12 @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6681)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[bug] Fix User profile update @theBeginner86 (#6778)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>added public content from the Meshery Catalog BookInfoForCatalogIstio @aryabyte21 (#6775)</li>
<li>[cypress] migrate to cypress version 12 @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6681)</li>
<li>Change updater workflow to mandate both flags @Revolyssup (#6791)</li>
<li>Change updater workflow @Revolyssup (#6790)</li>
<li>Add support for <code>component</code> level updation in MeshModels @Revolyssup (#6788)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Fixed Cilium calculation error on Compatibility Matrix @asubedy (#6801)</li>
<li>[Docs] Changed calculation logic on the compatibility matrix @asubedy (#6786)</li>
<li>Update README.md for better readability @chinu-anand (#6780)</li>
<li>Each adapter page source their adapter-version-number dynamically @ayushthe1 (#6672)</li>
<li>[Docs] Integrate Discussion Forum with Posts by Tag @leecalcote (#6773)</li>
<li>fix: style for overview class @Udit-takkar (#6784)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Chadha93, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @Udit-takkar, @UtkarshMishra12, @alphaX86, @aryabyte21, @asubedy, @ayushthe1, @chinu-anand, @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.4</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.4">Released</a> on August 31, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Reinstate gowrk2 submodule under <code>server</code> directory @alphaX86 (#6126)</li>
<li>Fix clone on filters @gr455 (#6117)</li>
<li>Upgrade nighthawk @gr455 (#6103)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-features">
	🚀 Features
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Server] Backend support for Meshery Catalog @gr455 (#6028)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>chore(mesheryctl): add loader to mesheryctl pattern apply @pk-218 (#6079)</li>
<li>fix(ci): update <code>docker-compose.yaml</code> path @pk-218 (#6111)</li>
<li>fix(ci/lint): fix failing lint check @pk-218 (#6113)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] 50% width for input in RJSF @Chadha93 (#6129)</li>
<li>[Extensions] Remote config icon update @Chadha93 (#6124)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.30.1 to 7.31.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6116)</li>
<li>[RJSF] fixed the size of the input field  @harkiratsm (#6101)</li>
<li>RJSF Validation @harkiratsm (#6114)</li>
<li>[Server] Backend support for Meshery Catalog @gr455 (#6028)</li>
<li>Added a textoverflow ellipsis for rjsf  @harkiratsm (#6104)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Server] Backend support for Meshery Catalog @gr455 (#6028)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Dependencies] meshkit and meshsync upgrades @leecalcote (#6130)</li>
<li>[CI] Issue labeling update @leecalcote (#6122)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.30.1 to 7.31.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6116)</li>
<li>echo log in core E2E workflow for debugging @Revolyssup (#6121)</li>
<li>Add_adapter_tests_resiliency_logic/#5900 @Zanda256 (#6102)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs]refactor: Merge Build and Releases page inside Contributing section @sambit-sankalp (#6074)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.40</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.40">Released</a> on December 31, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Solve leftover bug due to merge conflict @Revolyssup (#6813)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>add a support for CustomTextTooltip in the formContext @harkiratsm (#6815)</li>
<li>cypress: assign cy params to validate modal @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6812)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Meshery CLI Contributing Guide Details and Artifacts @leecalcote (#6811)</li>
<li>Updated design spec doc links to point to detailed design spec doc @eeshaanSA (#6797)</li>
<li>Add MeshModel endpoints to swagger docs @Revolyssup (#6806)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Revolyssup, @eeshaanSA, @harkiratsm, @leecalcote and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.41</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.41">Released</a> on January 06, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] Fix image path in meshmodel docs @gr455 (#6840)</li>
<li>Update SVG width and height in component updation @Revolyssup (#6839)</li>
<li>[MeshModel] Define Status Types @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6831)</li>
<li>Lowercase fields inside MeshModel metadata @Revolyssup (#6837)</li>
<li>Migrate to MeshModel registry in pattern engine @Revolyssup (#6728)</li>
<li>[CI] Fix build status badge in readme.md @leecalcote (#6828)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump json5 from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6834)</li>
<li>Bump json5 from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#6835)</li>
<li>New configurations appear in the list after being imported @hs05june (#6818)</li>
<li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.14.0 to 1.15.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6821)</li>
<li>[General] Just replaced the code for deleting an application with an … @partik03 (#6800)</li>
<li>Bump postcss from 8.4.17 to 8.4.20 in /ui @dependabot (#6822)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump golang.org/x/text from 0.4.0 to 0.5.0 @dependabot (#6824)</li>
<li>Bump json5 from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6834)</li>
<li>[CI] Workflow update meshery.io docs with meshmodel components @gr455 (#6838)</li>
<li>workflow to update discussions data files added @deepakdinesh1123 (#6832)</li>
<li>Bump json5 from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#6835)</li>
<li>Bump start-server-and-test from 1.14.0 to 1.15.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6821)</li>
<li>Bump postcss from 8.4.17 to 8.4.20 in /ui @dependabot (#6822)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.42</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.42">Released</a> on January 12, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Refactor pattern engine logic to avoid invalid components  @Revolyssup (#6872)</li>
<li>Bump json5 from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#6836)</li>
<li>fix panic @Revolyssup (#6866)</li>
<li>updated the link Meshery Contributors Welcome Guide @VedRatan (#6855)</li>
<li>fix applications update not reflected @MUzairS15 (#6854)</li>
<li>Fix component updater workflow logic @Revolyssup (#6853)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>improve <code>meshery pattern list</code> cmd error message @ayushthe1 (#6852)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.43</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.43">Released</a> on January 13, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Conversion] name, namespace, labels and annotations as root field @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6878)</li>
<li>[MeshModel] Fix problem with #6875 @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6876)</li>
<li>[MeshModel] Update API Routes to Allow Optional URL Vars @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6875)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] improve error message shown to users for &ldquo;mesheryctl system channel&rdquo; command #6274 @devkapilbansal (#6430)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Playground] Redirect to playground based on capabilities, remove multiple api calls for capability query @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6879)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>correction in numbering of steps @AnnuCode (#6874)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @AnnuCode, @Revolyssup, @alphaX86, @devkapilbansal, @leecalcote and @sudo-NithishKarthik</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.44</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.44">Released</a> on January 16, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix wrong gRPC address in Pattern Engine @Revolyssup (#6900)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/containerd/containerd from 1.6.6 to 1.6.12 in /scripts/component_generation @dependabot (#6894)</li>
<li>Bump helm.sh/helm/v3 from 3.8.2 to 3.10.3 in /scripts/component_generation @dependabot (#6882)</li>
<li>Update .nvmrc @leecalcote (#6884)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.45</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.45">Released</a> on January 21, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Write SVG on UI file system @Revolyssup (#6769)</li>
<li>Add XML tag on SVGs in component updation  @Revolyssup (#6901)</li>
<li>Add <code>isNamespaced</code> in Meshmodel component metadata @Revolyssup (#6912)</li>
<li>Add model field in Application generated design @Revolyssup (#6913)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Added Meshconfig support for provider enforcement @abdullah1308 (#6644)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>refactor the code for redirecting to playground @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6916)</li>
<li>Fix SVG problems in Meshery-UI @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6690)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[bug] Fix empty component registration @theBeginner86 (#6917)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Added token on discussion file update workflow @asubedy (#6909)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add updated_after query parameter @Revolyssup (#6918)</li>
<li>Updating Meshery Broker and MeshSync [Docs] @sassukeuchiha (#6910)</li>
<li>Update navigation bar [Docs] @sassukeuchiha (#6906)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Added Meshconfig support for provider enforcement @abdullah1308 (#6644)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Revolyssup, @UtkarshMishra12, @abdullah1308, @alphaX86, @asubedy, @leecalcote, @sassukeuchiha and @theBeginner86</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.46</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.46">Released</a> on January 28, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix empty and duplicate outputs in MeshModel APIs @Revolyssup (#6941)</li>
<li>Add K8s MeshModel components @Revolyssup (#6936)</li>
<li>Fix SVG Bug and update fields @Revolyssup (#6933)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Created &lsquo;mesheryctl system provider&rsquo;  @abdullah1308 (#6928)</li>
<li>improved error message for system cmd - config, logs @kernelpanic77 (#6930)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Minor changes on NPM packages @acald-creator (#6888)</li>
<li>Ignore locally registered MeshModel package icons @leecalcote (#6945)</li>
<li>rename public to published for catalog @MUzairS15 (#6938)</li>
<li>[UI] Undeploy later button color update @Chadha93 (#6944)</li>
<li><code>provider-ui</code> MUI framework upgrade @acald-creator (#6911)</li>
<li>Notification center consistently opens when clicked @deepakdinesh1123 (#6905)</li>
<li>remove the description for additional fields @harkiratsm (#6861)</li>
<li>[UI] MeshModel Summary in Meshery Settings @theBeginner86 (#6771)</li>
<li>Changes made to Navigator Menu to remove some of the errors @deepakdinesh1123 (#6927)</li>
<li>Made Toggle Buttons on customize addon synchronous @hs05june (#6925)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Ignore locally registered MeshModel package icons @leecalcote (#6945)</li>
<li>[chore] Upgrade Meshkit to v0.6.21 @theBeginner86 (#6942)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump rack from 2.2.5 to 2.2.6.2 in /docs @dependabot (#6915)</li>
<li>Bump globalid from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 in /docs @dependabot (#6919)</li>
<li>Bump commonmarker from 0.23.6 to 0.23.7 in /docs @dependabot (#6929)</li>
<li>typographical error in quick-start.html @b0id (#6934)</li>
<li>Resolving the Grammatical Mistake in README.md @ShivangShandilya (#6932)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Chadha93, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @ShivangShandilya, @UtkarshMishra12, @abdullah1308, @acald-creator, @alphaX86, @b0id, @deepakdinesh1123, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @harkiratsm, @hs05june, @kernelpanic77, @l5io, @leecalcote, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.47</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.47">Released</a> on January 31, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">

</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Update maintainers.md @nishantwrp (#6953)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fixed snackbar close button not working in UserPreference @suyashvsingh (#6958)</li>
<li>[bug] Fix the missing &ldquo;Add Cluster&rdquo; button @theBeginner86 (#6949)</li>
<li>[UI] Use new svg system in rjsf @Chadha93 (#6951)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">

</h2>
<ul>
<li>[bug] Fix the missing &ldquo;Add Cluster&rdquo; button @theBeginner86 (#6949)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Revert go-git @acald-creator (#6959)</li>

<li>[bug] Fix the missing &ldquo;Add Cluster&rdquo; button @theBeginner86 (#6949)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">

@Chadha93, @acald-creator, @leecalcote, @nishantwrp, @suyashvsingh, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.48</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.48">Released</a> on February 02, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Revert Makefile.core.mk @acald-creator (#6961)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>improve debug logs for the <code>mesheryctl pattern apply</code> cmd @ayushthe1 (#6935)</li>
<li>error messages for mesheryctl system and mesheryctl system token improved @deepakdinesh1123 (#6955)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump postcss from 8.4.20 to 8.4.21 in /ui @dependabot (#6974)</li>
<li>add svg for published @MUzairS15 (#6970)</li>
<li>Dark theme of meshery @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6527)</li>
<li>Telemetry Providers @MUzairS15 (#6868)</li>
<li>[UI] Move to small icon for rjsf custom components @Chadha93 (#6962)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump postcss from 8.4.20 to 8.4.21 in /ui @dependabot (#6974)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/briandowns/spinner from 1.19.0 to 1.20.0 @dependabot (#6978)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Server] Designs: add share functionality @MUzairS15 (#6950)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
