<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.49</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.49">Released</a> on February 03, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Revert to before Kompose @acald-creator (#6990)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Switch the logic in querying Kubernetes cluster config, and removed <code>&lt;br /&gt;</code> @acald-creator (#6983)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Quick fix @acald-creator (#6992)</li>
<li>[Server] Add Support for Dry Run @sudo-NithishKarthik (#6903)</li>
<li>Added disabled icon theme color[For Extention] @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6991)</li>
<li>[Confirmation Modal] Add triangular badge in Confirmation Modal @Abhishek-kumar09 (#6986)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshsync from 0.6.8 to 0.6.9 @dependabot (#6973)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshkit from 0.6.22 to 0.6.23 @dependabot (#6975)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add apiVersion as query param for MeshModel components @Revolyssup (#6985)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Harshit-Dandriyal, @Revolyssup, @acald-creator, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @leecalcote and @sudo-NithishKarthik</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.5</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.5">Released</a> on September 03, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix whitespacing issue for ALL components @Revolyssup (#6142)</li>
<li>Refactor Helm charts @alphaX86 (#6138)</li>
<li>Enhance notification centre by adding support for notifications from PatternOps @Revolyssup (#6105)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Adding support to system channel docs  @legendarykamal (#6007)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump caniuse-lite from 1.0.30001357 to 1.0.30001387 in /ui @dependabot (#6154)</li>
<li>[WIP] catalog in meshery ui @warunicorn19 (#6027)</li>
<li>Design Panel Metrics Changes @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6158)</li>
<li>Bump @cypress/code-coverage from 3.9.12 to 3.10.0 in /ui @dependabot (#6156)</li>
<li>Bump @fortawesome/react-fontawesome from 0.1.18 to 0.2.0 in /ui @dependabot (#6159)</li>
<li>Bump @material-ui/lab from 4.0.0-alpha.60 to 4.0.0-alpha.61 in /ui @dependabot (#6155)</li>
<li>Bump codemirror from 5.65.5 to 5.65.8 in /ui @dependabot (#6157)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.10.0 to 11.10.4 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6145)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 10.6.0 to 10.7.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#6146)</li>
<li>[Cypress] Fix provider Login issue for Filter_spec integration @Chadha93 (#6139)</li>
<li>UI: Fix icons alignment in header @Nikhil-Ladha (#6134)</li>
<li>Fix custom configuration for Service Mesh @MUzairS15 (#6132)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.50</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.50">Released</a> on February 07, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Update Dockerfile to fix permission issue @Revolyssup (#7016)</li>
<li>new edge type relationships @MUzairS15 (#7005)</li>
<li>Fix apiVersion bug in dynamically generated Kubernetes components @Revolyssup (#7001)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix modal behaviour @MUzairS15 (#7024)</li>
<li>[UI] Extensions style bugs fix which were affecting light mode. @Chadha93 (#7017)</li>
<li>Turn configuration option blue on selection  @mohit-marathe (#7011)</li>
<li>[UI] Footer color fix for dark mode light mode and playground @Chadha93 (#7010)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Krishna2323/enhancement/docs website @Krishna2323 (#6639)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.51</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.51">Released</a> on February 11, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Skip dry run for meshery defined apiVersions in Meshmodel components @Revolyssup (#7054)</li>
<li>Allow components inside Node @Revolyssup (#7041)</li>
<li>upgrade meshkit @Revolyssup (#7040)</li>
<li>Allow cross version deployment of meshmodel components @Revolyssup (#6988)</li>
<li>Update component updater workflow to update only published models @Revolyssup (#7026)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Refactor <code>mesheryctl mesh</code> commands @alphaX86 (#6921)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Extension] prevent dark mode in extension, until supported @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7055)</li>
<li>[UI] Confirmation Modal and deployment badges @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7045)</li>
<li>Fixed Dark mode button @AdityaPote (#7014)</li>
<li>Fix: SVG scaling Problem in MesheryMeshInterface  @thisiskaransgit (#7034)</li>
<li>fix: style of input and white bg @harkiratsm (#7033)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @AdityaPote, @Chadha93, @Revolyssup, @alphaX86, @harkiratsm, @l5io, @leecalcote, @thisiskaransgit and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.52</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.52">Released</a> on February 20, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump github.com/containerd/containerd from 1.6.12 to 1.6.18 in /scripts/component_generation @dependabot (#7100)</li>
<li>Refactoring registration function &amp; adding mutex for thread-safety @Azanul (#7098)</li>
<li>Fix panic caused by unchecked nil checks @Revolyssup (#7108)</li>
<li>Remove redundant logs @Revolyssup (#7099)</li>
<li>Prettify Event messages for k8s registration @Revolyssup (#7091)</li>
<li>Push events to show no of registered components @Revolyssup (#7083)</li>
<li>fix panic @Revolyssup (#7082)</li>
<li>Enhance metadata of dynamically generated k8s components @Revolyssup (#7051)</li>
<li>Deny designs save with empty service name from Meshery Extensions @Revolyssup (#7046)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-features">
	🚀 Features
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Extension] Meshery Server Registration @theBeginner86 (#7065)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Fixed bug of settings page @partik03 (#6957)</li>
<li>use omitEmpty JSON and YAML tags for Namespace @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7103)</li>
<li>[Extension] Show troubleshooting modal if extension is broken @Nikhil-Ladha (#7113)</li>
<li>[Bug] Fix eslint failiure for UI @Chadha93 (#7109)</li>
<li>Bump cron-time-generator from 1.3.0 to 1.3.2 in /ui @dependabot (#6968)</li>
<li>[UI] Added Dark mode support to footer @Yashsharma1911 (#7090)</li>
<li>[Fix] Cypress integration Test failure @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7093)</li>
<li>Add a sibling relationship  @harkiratsm (#7089)</li>
<li>Bump @sideway/formula from 3.0.0 to 3.0.1 in /ui @dependabot (#7038)</li>
<li>[Docs] Fix typos  @thisiskaransgit (#7043)</li>
<li>Enabled Pagination @hs05june (#7085)</li>
<li>Adds custom names to catalog clone API @gr455 (#6652)</li>
<li>[Server] update graphql subscription and schema @MUzairS15 (#7068)</li>
<li>Revert &ldquo;Adding GIFs&rdquo; @leecalcote (#7069)</li>
<li>Adding GIFs @Shivam-AfA (#7056)</li>
<li>[bug] Meshery Provider UI: Fix Infinite Request To Fetch Providers From Server @theBeginner86 (#7052)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.53</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.53">Released</a> on February 23, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix all dryRun errors and change response format @Revolyssup (#7149)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/containerd/containerd from 1.6.15 to 1.6.18 in /scripts/component_updation @dependabot (#7122)</li>
<li>Bump golang.org/x/net from 0.5.0 to 0.7.0 in /scripts/component_updation @dependabot (#7123)</li>
<li>Fix Meshmodel structure @Revolyssup (#7121)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Fix regression issue of notification icon and svg scaling issue @Chadha93 (#7156)</li>
<li>Fixed theme colour should be consistent in settings and configuration page for dark mode @Yashsharma1911 (#7152)</li>
<li>fixed svg in meshperformance @yash37158 (#7137)</li>
<li>fixed: Footer not supporting dark mode @Yashsharma1911 (#7139)</li>
<li>Update ui_dev_server.js @acald-creator (#7130)</li>
<li>[chore] Upgrade eslint to v8 @acald-creator (#7124)</li>
<li>Fix the regression of playground footer @Chadha93 (#7129)</li>
<li>Fixed: Dashboard not quite right in Meshery-UI and MeshMap @Yashsharma1911 (#7118)</li>
<li>Remove title from _document.js file in provider-ui @Nikhil-Ladha (#7117)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump github.com/containerd/containerd from 1.6.15 to 1.6.18 @dependabot (#7101)</li>
<li>[chore] Upgrade eslint to v8 @acald-creator (#7124)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fixed jquery error  @VIKAS0264 (#7134)</li>
<li>fix extension points link in api.md file @vishalvivekm (#7136)</li>
<li>Update tooltip text @vishalvivekm (#7144)</li>
<li>add dark mode styles to table elements and head @rinkuhasija (#7131)</li>
<li>Fix the incorrect link @pratik2315 (#7127)</li>
<li>Update all code snippets to new style in Meshery Docs @chinu-anand (#7094)</li>
<li>Updated Meshery Token UI .png @b0id (#7119)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Chadha93, @Nikhil-Ladha, @Revolyssup, @VIKAS0264, @Yashsharma1911, @acald-creator, @b0id, @chinu-anand, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @leecalcote, @pratik2315, @rinkuhasija, @vishalvivekm and @yash37158</p>

    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.55</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.55">Released</a> on February 24, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Complete prettification flow @Revolyssup (#7185)</li>
<li>Fix whitespacing issue @Revolyssup (#7182)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Replace the older GetLatestReleaseTag function with meshkit function @Revolyssup (#7188)</li>
<li>fix wrongly handled error causing panic in mesheryctl @Revolyssup (#7189)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI][FIX] Disabled Signup button for the users who already have the extension/the capability to use meshmap @krishna9304 (#7177)</li>
<li>[UI][FIX] Retained the expected behaviour for consecutive clicks on the K8sContextMenu icon and Settings icon respectively @krishna9304 (#7186)</li>
<li>feat: rjsf dependency upgrade to v5 @harkiratsm (#7060)</li>
<li>Fix NATS/MeshSync connectivity test @MUzairS15 (#5866)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[chore] Improve Extension Proxy @theBeginner86 (#7184)</li>
<li>[chore] Update Remote Provider URL for dev env @theBeginner86 (#7183)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @MUzairS15, @Revolyssup, @harkiratsm, @krishna9304, @leecalcote, @theBeginner86 and l5io</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.58">Released</a> on February 28, 2023</h4>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.59</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.59">Released</a> on March 02, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump golang.org/x/net from 0.5.0 to 0.7.0 in /scripts/component_generation @dependabot (#7250)</li>
<li>fix greedy search in /meshmodel/model/{model} @Revolyssup (#7225)</li>
<li>Trim whitespace from Meshmodel model names for websites @Revolyssup (#7224)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add links, captions as annotation tags in <code>mesheryctl</code> files @alphaX86 (#7205)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Made Navigator Icons Consistent @hs05june (#7203)</li>
<li>Bump @mui/icons-material from 5.11.0 to 5.11.11 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7236)</li>
<li>Fixed clickable area issue in header settings button. @sidtohan (#7147)</li>
<li>Bump eslint from 8.34.0 to 8.35.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7235)</li>
<li>Bump jss from 10.9.2 to 10.10.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7234)</li>
<li>Corrected background of Metrics in Dark Mode @hs05june (#7251)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.10.5 to 11.10.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7242)</li>
<li>Bump webpack-cli from 4.10.0 to 5.0.1 in /ui @dependabot (#7241)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 12.4.0 to 12.7.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7237)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.10.5 to 11.10.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7239)</li>
<li>Bump immutable from 4.1.0 to 4.2.4 in /ui @dependabot (#7238)</li>
<li>removing an non kubernetes exception in Json schema @harkiratsm (#7216)</li>
<li>[chore] Fix issues with loading User Account Extension @theBeginner86 (#7153)</li>
<li>Feat: add space btw dashboard sections @thisiskaransgit (#7221)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[chore] Fix issues with loading User Account Extension @theBeginner86 (#7153)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump @mui/icons-material from 5.11.0 to 5.11.11 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7236)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.37.0 to 0.41.0 @dependabot (#7240)</li>
<li>Bump eslint from 8.34.0 to 8.35.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7235)</li>
<li>Bump jss from 10.9.2 to 10.10.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7234)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/react from 11.10.5 to 11.10.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7242)</li>
<li>Bump webpack-cli from 4.10.0 to 5.0.1 in /ui @dependabot (#7241)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 12.4.0 to 12.7.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7237)</li>
<li>Bump @emotion/styled from 11.10.5 to 11.10.6 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7239)</li>
<li>Bump immutable from 4.1.0 to 4.2.4 in /ui @dependabot (#7238)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshsync from 0.6.7 to 0.6.9 @dependabot (#7243)</li>
<li>[chore] Fix issues with loading User Account Extension @theBeginner86 (#7153)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>add hover color for hyperlinks @rinkuhasija (#7227)</li>
<li>Add docs for setting up development environment on Windows @mohit-marathe (#7209)</li>
<li>Add links, captions as annotation tags in <code>mesheryctl</code> files @alphaX86 (#7205)</li>
<li>Deleted Extra Lines in code @Nikhil26112 (#7217)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Nikhil26112, @Revolyssup, @alphaX86, @asubedy, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @harkiratsm, @hs05june, @leecalcote, @mohit-marathe, @rinkuhasija, @sidtohan, @theBeginner86, @thisiskaransgit and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.6</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.6">Released</a> on September 06, 2022</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Helm] Preventing meshery-perf and meshery-cpx from installing by default || Fix #6178 @acald-creator (#6182)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] CatalogFilter btn bug fix @Chadha93 (#6183)</li>
<li>Added Namespace Background SVGs @Harshit-Dandriyal (#6125)</li>
<li>minor ui changes to the catalog @warunicorn19 (#6177)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-patterns-filters-applications">
	🔋 Patterns, Filters, Applications
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] CatalogFilter btn bug fix @Chadha93 (#6183)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">

</h2>
<ul>

</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.62</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.62">Released</a> on March 07, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add search by display name in greedy meshmodel search @Revolyssup (#7302)</li>
<li>fix meshmodel duplicates  @Revolyssup (#7299)</li>
<li>Added Antonette Cardwell to maintainers @Shivam-AfA (#6948)</li>
<li>Do not registered unpublished components and fix modelDisplayName @Revolyssup (#7288)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add meshmodel-categories svgs @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7300)</li>
<li>[UI] Fixed User Preferences Tabs @soham4abc (#7285)</li>
<li>Troubleshoot Guide Dark Mode @hs05june (#7289)</li>
<li>This PR fixes #7265  @parmishh (#7267)</li>
<li>Search Filter remains on Pagination @hs05june (#7281)</li>
<li>Fixed RJSF input tooltip disappearing on hover @asubedy (#7268)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Release table text alignment fix @gurpreet-legend (#7270)</li>
<li>Platform compatibility matrix alignment fix @gurpreet-legend (#7272)</li>
<li>[Docs]: Added create new file feature @soham4abc (#7260)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Chadha93, @Revolyssup, @Shivam-AfA, @asubedy, @gurpreet-legend, @hs05june, @l5io, @leecalcote, @parmishh, @soham4abc, Gurpreet Singh and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.63</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.63">Released</a> on March 13, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>add endpoint to get user by id (uuid) @MUzairS15 (#7301)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Modify <code>Default</code> to <code>default</code> in token @alphaX86 (#7311)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Color of Metrics Tab when selected fixed @soham4abc (#7294)</li>
<li>New MeshModel Icons added @ritiksaxena124 (#7335)</li>
<li>fixed the alignment and space of some icons @sidtohan (#7277)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[bug] Handle Meshery server de-registration gracefully @theBeginner86 (#7310)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>aligned meshery operator with the heading @Ambareen09 (#7282)</li>
<li>fix table header background color on click @rinkuhasija (#7333)</li>
<li>added &ldquo;language: en&rdquo; to the frontmatter of all Docs pages that are in English  @hirentimbadiya (#7315)</li>
<li>kubernetes versions are sorted in descending order in the compatibili… @sudhanshutech (#7331)</li>
<li>Bump rack from 2.2.6.2 to 2.2.6.3 in /docs @dependabot (#7316)</li>
<li>Modify <code>Default</code> to <code>default</code> in token @alphaX86 (#7311)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Ambareen09, @Chadha93, @MUzairS15, @Nikhil-Ladha, @Revolyssup, @alphaX86, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @hirentimbadiya, @leecalcote, @rinkuhasija, @ritiksaxena124, @sidtohan, @soham4abc, @sudhanshutech, @theBeginner86 and MUzairS15</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.64</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.64">Released</a> on March 14, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Generate new components and dump csv @Revolyssup (#7349)</li>
<li>Add trim flag for /api/meshmodel/model/<modelname>  @Revolyssup (#7344)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>feat: suggestions for miss spelled sub commands @gurpreet-legend (#7308)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[MeshModels] add green svgs with label style @Abhishek-kumar09 (#7348)</li>
<li>[UI][FIX] Publish to meshery catalog action prevented for users signed in using local provider @krishna9304 (#7142)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Update meshery-ui doc contribution flow @senali-d (#7343)</li>
<li>[Docs] Fix table of contents not auto generated and add auto-scrolling @chinu-anand (#7307)</li>
<li>publish Meshery Connections and their Actions table in docs ( /architecture ) @vishalvivekm (#7317)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Revolyssup, @chinu-anand, @gurpreet-legend, @krishna9304, @leecalcote, @senali-d, @vishalvivekm and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.65</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.65">Released</a> on March 15, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Changed integrations filetype for meshery.io repo from json to js @asubedy (#7350)</li>
<li>Bump webpack from 5.70.0 to 5.76.1 in /install/docker-extension/ui @dependabot (#7354)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>All Meshmodel-categories Icons Added @ritiksaxena124 (#7345)</li>
<li>Fixed pattern bug @asubedy (#7360)</li>
<li>Bump webpack from 5.75.0 to 5.76.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7353)</li>
<li>Bump webpack from 5.75.0 to 5.76.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7352)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump webpack from 5.75.0 to 5.76.0 in /ui @dependabot (#7353)</li>
<li>Bump webpack from 5.75.0 to 5.76.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#7352)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Improve dark mode visibility of code snippet and click feedback to copy button. @chinu-anand (#7166)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.66</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.66">Released</a> on March 22, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix invalid SVG on dynamic meshmodel kubernetes component @Revolyssup (#7351)</li>
<li>MeshModel API restructure @Revolyssup (#7364 )</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>aligned icon in footer @soham4abc (#7275)</li>
<li>[UI] Added theme neutral background for meshery logo @soham4abc (#7341)</li>
<li>icons under actions are now visible in light mode @sudhanshutech (#7202)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>MeshSync icon aligned with heading @Ambareen09 (#7372)</li>
<li>sort endpoints alphabetically and group &rsquo;em by path hierarchy @vishalvivekm (#7367)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.6.68</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.6.68">Released</a> on March 27, 2023</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix K8s Meshmodel component schema @Revolyssup (#7399)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>app sub-command suggestions added @gurpreet-legend (#7376)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>feat: rjsf upgrade, remove code @harkiratsm (#7395)</li>
<li>Update Button in Storybook @acald-creator (#7391)</li>
<li>Setup Storybook in <code>ui</code> @acald-creator (#7389)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[bug] Fix: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference @theBeginner86 (#7393)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] Change golang version to warning @leecalcote (#7398)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Mark oam API endpoints as Deprecated @vishalvivekm (#7374)</li>

<li>Fixed broken build-and-release link @adarshrajpathak (#7397)</li>
</ul>
